description: A CBC News investigation has identified the Canadian woman arrested last week in Belgium on espionage charges as Biwei Zhang, a systems engineer who has previously worked for the Canadian Space Agency and Statistics Canada. Identifying information from Zhang's social media profiles, graduate thesis and a federal court case matched Belgian authorities' description of the NATO intern apprehende
title: Alleged spy worked for Canadian government agencies before NATO internship, CBC finds

description: After counsellors and community leaders spoke out against the sudden funding cut, Indigenous Services Canada told CBC News they had found funding to help residential school survivors and their families travel to access counselling.
title: Feds find funding for residential school survivors, providers to travel for counselling in N.W.T., Nunavut

description: CBC Sports' daily newsletter recaps a relatively quiet day for Canada at the Commonwealth Games, which included a gold by shot putter Sarah Mitton. Plus, who to watch on Day 7.
title: Commonwealth Games guide: Mitton strikes gold, and who to watch Thursday

description: Some of the Island's oldest burial grounds are at risk, as coastal erosion washes away the land beneath them. People are doing what they can to protect those cemeteries but, as CBC's Cody MacKay explains, eventually they will be lost to the sea.
title: Erosion is washing away some of P.E.I.’s historical gravesites

description: The Tribunal administratif de déontologie policière concluded that Sgt. Simon Deveault-Bonenfant and officer François Bleau-Goulet of the Sûreté du Québec engaged in discriminatory actions based on the colour of Leslie Blot's skin in a 2020 traffic stop.
title: 2 Quebec police officers racially profiled Black man during traffic stop: ethics tribunal

description: The Duesseldorf-based company Unifer will purchase two million tonnes per year of LNG for up to 20 years, with first deliveries expected in 2032.
title: German utility locks in long-term LNG purchasing deal from B.C.'s Ksi Lisims

description: Some Toronto residents are demanding a one-year moratorium on two proposed data centre projects in the city's Etobicoke and Scarborough areas.
title: Toronto residents push for moratorium on data centres in city, raise concerns over environmental impact

description: This spring, the province passed a law allowing it to take over municipal land for its planned expansion of Billy Bishop Airport. On Wednesday, days after the federal government rejected the province's proposal for the island airport, Toronto city council voted to demand the Ford government give it back.
title: Toronto council demands Ford government return land province took for rejected Billy Bishop Airport expansion

description: Kayla Boisvert of Trenton, Ont., was last seen July 27.
title: Ontario paramedic missing from B.C. music festival: police

description: A woman in her twenties is dead after falling from a mountain near Marvel Peak, according to police.
title: 2nd hiker in a week dies after falling from Banff National Park mountain

description: After 12 children were injured in June by an electrical shock at Cultus Lake Waterpark, the park has begun a phased reopening starting July 29, following a six-week closure for safety investigations.
title: B.C. water park begins reopening after June electrical incident that sent 12 children to hospital

description: Of particular concern is the Pear Lake wildfire, roughly 20 kilometres from Clinton, B.C. — the largest active wildfire in the province at about 669 square kilometres — which has already destroyed several properties.
title: Wind fans flames of wildfires across B.C., as officials warn fires will likely grow this week

description: Calgary police say new information has prompted investigators to search an area in the northeast part of the city as they continue to try to locate 11-year-old Parker, who has been missing for nearly two weeks.
title: Police search additional area for missing Calgary boy as possible new evidence emerges

description: After a woman posted on Facebook about the damage to her daycare in Sandy Bay, Sask., several local men showed up to repair the rafters and cover the insulation with tarps.
title: Residents step up after roof blows off daycare in remote Sask. community

description: The shallowest of the Great Lakes has seen a drop of roughly 20 per cent, according to an Ontario regulatory body. A swell in the number of walleye and climate change are some of the reasons why, scientists say.
title: What’s behind Lake Erie’s steep yellow perch decline?

description: WestJet, Canada's second-largest airline, is preparing to wind-down operations ahead of a potential strike or lockout by its flight attendants. But an agreement to gradually halt operations doesn't mean the company is guaranteed to go through a labour dispute, as negotiations between the union and the company continue.
title: Despite WestJet wind-down plans, a strike isn't a sure bet, but the clock is ticking

description: The senior corrections officer targeted in an alleged murder plot that sparked the Project South investigation denied planting a weapon in the cell of an inmate, as he testified Wednesday in response to that inmate's Charter breach application, which the jail official described as "a further platform to victimize me."
title: Toronto jail official targeted in alleged murder plot denies planting weapon in cell

description: The federal and Alberta governments have signed an agreement to allow municipalities across the province to access hundreds of millions of dollars to invest in water and infrastructure and spur new housing developments.
title: New Alberta-Canada infrastructure agreement aims to accelerate housing development

description: Danièle Sauvageau steered Canada to its first Olympic gold medal in women's hockey in 2002. She's been tasked with doing it again in 2030.
title: Danièle Sauvageau, who coached Canadian women's hockey team to 1st gold medal, returns as new GM

description: Police are investigating an early-morning fire at Hamilton's Christie Lake Conservation Area that forced the YMCA to close its Camp Chippewa program for the week and remove children from the property by bus on Wednesday after the fire damaged facilities in the area.
title: Dozens of children bused from YMCA camp after Hamilton conservation area fire damages structures

description: When Louisiana's Jeff Daglaris lost his wedding ring at the bottom of a Nova Scotia lake, he turned to the internet for advice and the answer was simple: call Nate McLagan.
title: N.S. metal detector operator dives to find Louisiana man's submerged wedding band

description: New York State Police officers testified Wednesday about what they saw before divers recovered the body of a nine-year-old Montreal girl submerged in shallow, muddy water in a rural area last summer.
title: New York police diver testifies about discovery of 9-year-old Montreal girl's body

description: Former Kitchener, Ont., neurologist Jeffrey Sloka, who was acquitted in April on 48 counts of sexual assault, is due back in court early in the new year to face two separate sexual assault charges, relating to alleged incidents in 2011 and 2013.
title: Ontario trial dates set for ex-neurologist Jeffrey Sloka on additional sexual assault charges

description: Hundreds of young people filled a Toronto job fair on Wednesday in the hopes of snagging a summer job at the Canadian National Exhibition.
title: More than 50,000 people applied for seasonal jobs with the Canadian National Exhibition this year: CEO

description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection is suspending its operations at the Montréal-Trudeau International Airport, leading to multiple flight cancellations Wednesday.

title: B.C.'s air quality is worsening due to wildfires, report finds

description: There are 122 active wildfires across northwestern Ontario, according to the latest update from Ontario's Aviation, Forest Fire and Emergency Services (AFFES) issued on Tuesday evening. Here's what we know about how they're affecting communities across the region.
title: Here's the latest on northwestern Ontario's forest fires: Wednesday, July 29

description: Family alleges there was a lack of communication and collaboration about toddler’s care.
title: Mother speaks out after child with autism dismissed from daycare

description: Several service clubs in Ontario say they are struggling to keep up membership, as longtime members age out of volunteering and prospective new members are scarce. It leaves the future of Optimist, Rotary and Lions clubs, and the many community initiatives that they offer, at risk.
title: Service clubs used to be the pillar of communities. Now, members are aging out

description: Canadian taxpayers spent more to protect Prince Harry during his visits to Canada over a five-year period than for any other internationally protected person who visited Canada during that time. An RCMP document obtained by CBC News provides a rare glimpse into the secretive world of protecting internationally protected persons.
title: Security for Prince Harry's visits to Canada topped all internationally protected persons
